changes.title: Henge ring
items: The stone shrine's henges are rings of standing stones again, not a ring of little stone circles
The stone shrine's woods are great standing stones now, tall and weathered, instead of flat lily-pad rocks
The ravine's rock spires are stacked layers of rock with mossy ledges, not a speckled column
Every legend's circle is ringed by the area's tallest pieces, even where there are no trees

changes.title: Smooth leash route
items: Flying the treetops with animals on the leash, their dotted travel paths glide to each new route instead of jumping

changes.title: Legend kin
items: A legend circle's card now speaks of the elder's kin, not its children
